info.about: Medabots: Metabee and Medabots: Rokusho is a set of two 2D top-down role-playing video games in the Medabots series, developed by Natsume Co., Ltd. for Game Boy Advance. It is a remake of the Japan-exclusive title Medarot 2 , which was released for the Game Boy Color in 1999.
info.trivia: The Metabee and Rokusho versions are a remake of Medarot 2, a 1999 Game Boy Color game that was only ever released in Japan.
info.why: The RPG shares its name with the cheaper Medabots AX: Metabee fighting game, and genuine RPG cartridges ask several times as much.
